summary: Verified fix for '>1000 patients cannot save SOAP' bug. Created regression test that seeds 1000 filler patients + 1 TARGET patient (1001st) directly in MongoDB for a fresh doctor, creates a visit with SOAP for the target, then confirms retrieval via GET /api/visits?patient_id, GET /api/visits/{id}, PUT /api/visits/{id}. Also verified related endpoints (attachments, prescriptions, certificates, lab-requests) return the target patient's records, plus cross-owner isolation. All 12 tests PASSED in ~4s.
action_items: Pre-existing /app/backend/tests/test_soap_persistence_and_cache.py fails collection because it does not load /app/frontend/.env for REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL. Not in scope of this fix but easy improvement: add load_dotenv() calls at top of that file (as done in the new test).
critical_code_review_comments: Fix is correct: `.to_list(length=None)` used consistently in get_visits (l.808), get_attachments (l.1042), get_prescriptions (l.1193), get_certificates (l.1258), get_lab_requests (l.1323), and license-stats (l.2513).

Other still-capped enumerations found (not in scope of this bug but worth flagging): server.py:1874 `.to_list(10000)`, :2017/:2032/:2078 `.to_list(100000)` for patient owner enumeration in other code paths. If a doctor exceeds 10k patients these will silently truncate.
Consider adding an index on patients.owner_id to keep the unbounded find fast at scale.
test_credentials: Dynamic doctors registered per run (RUN_TAG_a@example.com / RUN_TAG_b@example.com, password TestPass123!); users + all seeded data cleaned up in teardown.
seed_data_creation: 1000 filler patients + 1 TARGET patient (1001st) inserted directly via motor for doctor A; 1 patient for doctor B; all removed in module teardown by owner_id/created_by.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Regression test lives at /app/backend/tests/test_soap_1000_patient_cap.py and self-contains seed + teardown. Run with `pytest backend/tests/test_soap_1000_patient_cap.py -v`. It requires both /app/backend/.env and /app/frontend/.env to be loadable.
rca of the issue: get_visits and 4 sibling list endpoints enumerated the doctor's owned patients with `.to_list(1000)`; for any patient beyond position 1000 the id was missing from the ownership `$in` list, so their visits/prescriptions/etc. were filtered out and the API returned an empty list. UI interpreted the empty response as 'notes not saved'. Fix removed the cap via `.to_list(length=None)`. Reproduction: seed >1000 patients for a doctor (target inserted last), POST /api/visits with SOAP for the target, GET /api/visits?patient_id=target — before fix returned [], after fix returns the visit with SOAP intact. Mitigation confirmed by the passing regression test.
